## 💡 Feature Idea
A clear and concise description of what you'd like to see.

## 🤔 Problem it Solves
What problem does this feature solve? What motivated this request?

## 📐 Proposed Solution
Describe how you imagine this feature working.

## 🎨 Mockups / Examples
Any sketches, screenshots from other apps, or examples that show what you mean.

## 📊 Priority
How important is this to you?
- [ ] Nice to have
- [ ] Important
- [ ] Critical to my daily use

## 📝 Additional Context
Anything else to add?
